notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). TypeScript guide for Azure Playwright Workspaces (@azure/playwright, successor to the retired @azure/microsoft-playwright-testing): service config with Entra credentials, running tests on cloud browsers, Azure reporter, manual browser connection, options/enums, GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines CI, and migration from the old package.

Tells the agent to run `npm init @azure/playwright@latest` (SKILL.md:21, executes the latest initializer package from npm, which generates config files), `npm install` of @azure/playwright, @playwright/test@^1.47 and @azure/identity (SKILL.md:24-26), `az login` (SKILL.md:46), and `npx playwright test --config=playwright.service.config.ts --workers=20` (SKILL.md:110), which authenticates with the user's Entra identity and runs the user's tests on cloud-hosted browsers. Medium because of the unpinned initializer/package installs and live-service credential use; acceptable because these are official Microsoft/Playwright packages and the commands act only on the user's own project and Playwright workspace.

Cloud test runs consume billable Playwright Workspaces capacity; `exposeNetwork: "<loopback>"` lets cloud browsers reach the user's localhost. CI YAML uses GitHub OIDC (id-token: write) and repository secrets for the user's own pipeline.
